description: This file contains unit tests for the Navigator component within the navigation system of the Android application. It verifies navigation behavior such as moving between top-level and sub-stacks, handling back navigation, and maintaining navigation state consistency.

classes.name: NavigatorTest
classes.description: Test class for validating the behavior of the Navigator component, including navigation and back stack operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, including creating a navigation state and navigator instance.

methods.name: testStartKey
methods.description: Verifies that the navigation state correctly initializes with the starting key.

methods.name: testNavigate
methods.description: Tests navigation to a different sub-stack key and verifies state updates.

methods.name: testNavigateTopLevel
methods.description: Checks navigating to a top-level key updates the current top-level key properly.

methods.name: testNavigateSingleTop
methods.description: Tests navigating to the same sub-stack key multiple times results in a single instance in the back stack.

methods.name: testNavigateTopLevelSingleTop
methods.description: Verifies that navigating to a top-level key again replaces the current sub-stack.

methods.name: testSubStack
methods.description: Ensures that navigating to a sub-key updates both current key and top-level key accordingly.

methods.name: testMultiStack
methods.description: Tests complex navigation involving multiple top-level and sub-stack navigations and back navigation.

methods.name: testPopOneNonTopLevel
methods.description: Verifies that back navigation removes the last sub-key without changing the top-level key.

methods.name: testPopOneTopLevel
methods.description: Tests that back navigation from a top-level key removes it and updates the current key and top-level key.

methods.name: popMultipleNonTopLevel
methods.description: Checks that multiple back navigations remove sub-keys until reaching a top-level key.

methods.name: popMultipleTopLevel
methods.description: Verifies multiple back navigations across multiple top-level stacks results in correct state.

methods.name: throwOnEmptyBackStack
methods.description: Ensures that invoking back navigation when the back stack is empty throws an exception.
